messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — new reranker bring-up (tiny-3B quant) shows NDCG ~0.06 lower than fp16 on long nested docs. Repro steps below. @Chris @Sam
Maya: baseline fp16: NDCG@10 = 0.462, quant int8: 0.401 (on holdout A). Not just variance — consistent across 3 runs.
Maya: suspecting doc-padding/truncation behavior when we pack multiple passages into "document" field. The offline eval harness uses simple truncation but runtime serving pads to max_len and rotates segments.
Chris: can you paste the eval command + config you're using?
Maya: sure:
```bash
python eval_rerank.py --model tiny-3b-int8 --dataset holdout_A.jsonl \
  --max_doc_tokens 3072 --doc_pack_strategy=append_then_truncate --batch 128
```
Maya: eval snippet:
```
NDCG@10: 0.462
MRR: 0.371
-- after int8
NDCG@10: 0.401
MRR: 0.348
```
Sam: hmm, pack strategy append_then_truncate sounds flaky for nested docs. Could be we truncate mid-passage causing context shift. Try "pack_by_passage" and maintain sentinel tokens between passages.
Chris: also check tokenizer differences — one harness uses HF tokenizer with add_special_tokens=False in preprocessing; serving uses model tokenizer default.
Maya: good point. I dumped token counts for a failing query — lots of tokens in the middle of passage boundary.
Leo: quick test idea: run eval on a trimmed subset but force identical tokenization pipeline to serving. You can reproduce with:
```py
from ingest import token_pipeline
tokens = token_pipeline(doc_text, add_special_tokens=False, max_len=3072)
```
DevBot: scheduled run 1912350001: rerank-eval /models/tiny-3b-int8 on holdout_A subset (5k) with pack_by_passage. ETA ~20m :gear:
Sam: also add a control: quant vs fp16 but with the same preproc seed and deterministic padding to rule out nondet KV-cache ordering.
Maya: will run the two forks and post results. If gap persists, we should check softmax calibration after PTQ (activation scaling).
Chris: thanks. If DevBot run reproduces, we can escalate to quant infra to re-check per-channel scale params.
Maya: assigning follow-up: @Sam take tokenizer parity; @Chris check PTQ calibration logs; I'll collect reproductions and attach a minimal failing example. :ok_hand:
DevBot: run complete 1912350765 — results uploaded to /tmp/rerank/1912349999-run.json
Maya: got the run. Preliminary: switching to pack_by_passage recovered ~0.03 NDCG (int8 -> 0.434). Still ~0.028 gap vs fp16. Uploading diff samples now.
Chris: thanks team. Let's sync tomorrow 10am if not resolved. End.
